title: Galaxy benchmark environment record
description: Machine + browser + viewport snapshot captured by the benchmark spec at the start of a run. Written to bench/environment.json (gitignored — machine-specific). The schema itself is tracked so reviewers can validate any environment.json that gets attached to a baseline re-bench report. See bench/README.md for the dev-bench flag policy.

recorded_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the benchmark run start (new Date().toISOString()).

os.description: Operating system label derived from navigator.userAgent / navigator.platform (e.g. 'Win32', 'Linux x86_64', 'macOS').

gpu.description: WebGL renderer string from WEBGL_debug_renderer_info (e.g. 'ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 ...)'). null when WebGL is unavailable — the spec records the absence rather than fabricating a value.

cpu_cores.description: navigator.hardwareConcurrency. Logical cores available to the JS runtime.

memory_gb.description: navigator.deviceMemory in GB (Chromium-only; rounded to powers of 2). null when the browser omits the API.

viewport.description: Playwright viewport size in CSS pixels (matches playwright.config.ts's chromium-realbackend project).

seed.description: Fixture seed label identifying which generated graphs were benched (e.g. 'graph-1k+graph-5k' or a git SHA). Lets a baseline re-bench pull the same fixtures.

machine_label.description: Free-text machine identifier. Defaults to 'dev (recorded locally)'; override with BENCH_MACHINE_LABEL env var when re-benching on the baseline hardware so the recorded file points at the right machine in reports.
